prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1211; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a reported fall onto an outstretched hand. The mechanism described is consistent with the distal radius injury identified on examination and imaging, and the findings clearly confirm a fracture in that location. Initial management included immobilization in a splint, analgesia, and orthopedic follow-up. Over three visits the patient's pain and swelling steadily decreased, range of motion improved, and the plan was tapered from immobilization to a home exercise program as healing progressed. The patient also mentioned a minor wrist strain several years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Treatment has been appropriate to the injury and the course has followed the expected pattern. Billed services reflect the visits documented here, with no duplicate charges identified.
